facts.fact: The minister said the last population and housing census was conducted in 2017 and was the country's first digital census.

The Ministry of Economic Planning and Development with UNFPA launched the 2027 Population and Housing Census, with the Central Statistical Office conducting the first phase, the mapping and listing exercise (launch said to be 'yesterday' relative to the 7 Nov 2025 article).
